scope: Read-only CPU audit; no model, simulator, new rollout, optimizer or network

execution.benchmark: 30-step full chunk; command(k, live_obs) on every control step
execution.frozen_advancement: post-step position <= .01 m AND rotation <= .08 rad OR dwell >= 30; one target per advancement; no width gate
execution.anchor: model: current observation once at predict/set_chunk; replay: original expert anchor per encoded chunk; to_native only recomputes live-relative command, not anchor
execution.gripper_contract: action index 6 is absolute total finger opening in metres; native action index 6 is 0 and width travels separately as gripper_width
execution.clip_flag_limits: command, workspace and width clipping included; joint slew max_joint_step not included in action_clipped flag
execution.budget: 900 env control steps, independent of target/chunk index; 30Hz control; 60Hz physics

width_intent.method: AST extracted unchanged _update_width_intent; no simulator module import
width_intent.limits: Isolated intent state-machine behavior only; no evidence that any model produced these sequences, and no physical contact/grasp is simulated.

wandb.interpretation: Logged training batches only, sampled by logging cadence; no validation loss or convergence claim. No W&B run initialized or synced.
